question: Can I use PDFIndi on mobile devices?
answer:
Yes! PDFIndi is fully mobile-friendly. Our website is designed to work seamlessly on all devices:

  • 📱 Mobile Phones: Android and iOS smartphones
  • 📲 Tablets: iPad, Android tablets
  • 💻 Laptops & Desktops: Windows, Mac, Linux
  • 🌐 All Browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera

No app installation needed! Simply open pdfindi.com in your mobile browser and access all tools instantly. The interface automatically adapts to your screen size for the best user experience.
